title: (c) Presence subscription on the HIRE service
description:
Layer (c) of the persona-3tly.7 decision: a stream carrying presence changes, so a HIRE-aware consumer learns the principal left without polling and without waiting for a TTL.

Rides on the second gRPC service from persona-jl4j.4, so the marginal cost is one RPC rather than a new surface. Note this is the layer a CONTINUOUSLY-sensed source wants most, because such a source produces no departure event for the (b) path to deliver -- it produces a continuous truth whose interruption is the signal.

DESIGN NOTE FOR persona-jl4j.5: for a continuous source, the proof cache and this subscription are the SAME machinery. The daemon holds a live subscription and the cached observation is simply the latest one, so proof age stays near zero and never needs a poll. Build the cache so a source can PUSH into it, not only be polled, or it gets rebuilt when the first continuous attestor lands.

Consumer attestation applies as it does everywhere: a caller that cannot be attested gets no subscription. A presence stream is a side channel about the human's physical whereabouts and should be no more freely available than a token is.
acceptance_criteria: A HIRE-aware consumer is notified of a presence change without polling; unattested callers are refused; the cache in persona-jl4j.5 accepts pushed observations.
